column2: My name is the perfect god of battle...
the $$大天使$$ of war, $$ミカエル$$!!
Now I have regained my complete $$記憶$$, I who faithfully serve the one true god...
You who should create a new $$世界$$...
You who bear the soul meant to become the next $$サタン$$...!
You who bear the soul meant to become the next $$ゴッド$$...!
By the bond passed down since ancient times,
I shall now test your strength!!
$$プリカ$$ too... $$プリカ$$ wants to fight with you, $$お兄ちゃん$$!!
To think you would try to fight alone without telling me...
Hmph! I cannot leave you to fight alone...
Fighting among companions... that's just too awful!!
that you want to fight together, too!?
As for you... I will protect you, even at the cost of my life!!
We awakened $$大天使$$ can be reborn through our armor even if we die anyway.
Hey, hey! At least let us save face a little!
